open_obligations: Check whether debate variants with judge interaction or abstention remain zero-sum.
Note Chen et al.'s own limitation that general-sum language games are unstudied.
Check that LLM debaters' outputs fit Chen et al.'s finite-action game model.
out.other_title: Definition of the two-agent debate game (answers, alternating statements, judge)
out.rationale: Irving et al. define debate as a zero-sum game where each agent maximises its probability of winning. Chen et al. state AI Safety via Debate is predominantly captured by zero-sum games, where coarse correlated and correlated equilibria are Nash equilibria, so the game can be played efficiently by minimising external regret.
out.scope: proposed DEPENDS_ON: modelling AI debate as a zero-sum game so that external-regret minimisation suffices
